description: Park rangers fell 34.1% between Sep 2024 and Jan 2026, the steepest decline among environmental occupations in OPM-based data; interpretation and visitor protection shift to volunteers and seasonal staff.

role_title: Biological Science Student Trainee (GS-0499) and other Pathways trainees
description: Student trainee occupations decreased significantly and the under-30 share fell to 7.9% (Jan 2026); probationary firings in Feb 2025 removed early-career trail crews, biologists and NEPA coordinators.

Wildland fire management headcount rose while most environmental occupations fell; USFS had 10,496 firefighters on board in May 2026 against an 11,300 goal; DOI is consolidating bureau fire programs in phases. Year-round fuels and prescribed fire work expands the role beyond suppression.
About 1,600 Forest Service employees with fire certifications departed by May 2025; ~10,000 non-fire USFS staff hold fire qualifications. Surge capacity now depends on a smaller collateral-duty pool.
OPM Phase One proposes realigning 0455 into 0404; work continues under a broader technician series, so EMST role profiles must carry the function rather than the series.

role_title: Zoology (0410), Horticulture (0437), Fish & Wildlife Administration (0480), Animal Science (0487) -> 0401
description: Four small professional series proposed for realignment into 0401, broadening the catch-all series and increasing the need for competency profiles within it.
Both proposed for realignment out of named series (0023 to an 01xx series; 0090 to 1001). Recreation planning remains a function in USFS/NPS/BLM/USACE.

role_title: Environmental Protection Assistant (0029), Sanitarian (0688), Environmental Health Technician (0698)
description: Paraprofessional and environmental-health series proposed for realignment into generic series (0303, 0601, 0640), removing named entry points for environmental compliance and health work.

role_title: Land Law Examining (0965), Geodesy (1372), Geodetic Technician (1374), Forest Products Technology (1380), Irrigation System Operation (0459)
description: Proposed realignments to 0901, 1301, 1311 and a trades family; specialized lands, geodetic and forest-products work continues inside broader series.

role_title: Senior environmental policy, legal and program managers (GS-15+)
description: ~8,000 employees in ~4,800 positions moved to Schedule Policy/Career (97% GS-15+), including 98 EPA legal staff; these roles become at-will while remaining career, changing the integrity context for statecraft.

role_title: Agency talent team members and SME-assessors
description: Talent teams expanded to 154 agencies with 1,000+ members; SME-QA train-the-trainer certified 53 master trainers. Technical staff now co-produce hiring assessments.

v1 exposure tags code 6 of 7 entry-level (P) tasks under 0028 core competencies as compressive/substitution/supervision, the highest of 13 series; with AI-assisted drafting normalizing, entry work shifts from drafting to verification.
USFS lost about a quarter of its non-fire workforce by May 2025 and told Congress it needs state and community partners; remaining staff shift toward agreement management and partner oversight.
Dispatch-center staffing fell 25-27% in Colorado and Nevada per a county staffing study; dispatch data-entry tasks are automatable but error-sensitive.

Core competency set is datacraft-dominant (7 of 8 core competencies DC primary) and 50% of entry tasks are coded compressive; the role is migrating toward model/data review and toward overlap with 1560 data science.
